summary: Populous entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Populous: The Beginning

emulation.notes: Use native PC compatibility fixes; PlayStation emulation only for comparison.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows PC capture with compatibility fixes

primary.version: Current GOG/PC route with compatibility fixes documented
primary.why: Populous: The Beginning is a PC-centered Bullfrog god-game/strategy entry, and the current GOG/PC route is the cleanest practical way to capture the full 3D campaign. The PlayStation port is useful for version comparison but is not the fidelity target.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current GOG or owned Windows PC release with compatibility fixes. Record storefront/build, OS, resolution/wrapper, input, campaign level, multiplayer state if sampled, and whether the PlayStation port was compared.

secondary.why: The PC route has stronger capture and is the original strategy-control target.

all_releases.fidelity: Original PC route with modern compatibility/capture options.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No sourced platform-exclusive campaign content changes the PC primary route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record wrapper/compatibility state and do not merge with the earlier 2D Populous games.
